post_processing_note: Normalized the temporary update-tagged official name to match the approved research package; candidate UI continues to use the stable core title.

design_system.theme: Collector's shelf — warm cream paper with stitched cards, collector hang-tags, and an original pure-CSS plush mascot; playful soft-toy aesthetic, not generic SaaS and not a Roblox clone.
design_system.font_strategy: System font stack only (ui-rounded, SF Pro Rounded, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif); fluid type via clamp() steps -1 to 4; no external fonts.
responsive_rules: 375px: single column everywhere, full-width primary hero CTA, hamburger nav below 768px, plush stage shrinks to 260px.
768px: card grids move to 2-3 columns, controls row of 3, footer becomes two columns.
1440px: content capped at 1120px container, hero splits 1.15fr/0.85fr with mascot on the right, fluid type tops out.
No horizontal overflow at any width (overflow-x guard plus min() container widths).

hero.headline: Collect, trade, and complete your Jellycat shelf.
hero.subheadline: Trade A Jellycat! is a Roblox collecting game by Jellycats Wow! where you open plush crates, grow a collection of soft-toy Jellycats, and trade with friends on the trading board — with every statement on this site marked as confirmed fact or practical tip.

sections: Hero with CSS plush mascot and dual CTAs
What is Trade A Jellycat! (three confirmed-fact cards: crates, rarity, trading board)
Core gameplay loop (numbered steps: crates → review → trade)

page_map.purpose: Positioning, hero CTAs, confirmed game overview, core loop, controls teaser, FAQ teaser
Quick start, verified core loop, approved-facts-only progression route, common mistakes framed as tips
Step-by-step trading-board walkthrough, control reference, practical trading tips
Fact-checked FAQ with explicit honest-unknown answers for odds, tiers, codes, and updates
